{{Quote|Huff Darklighter? The head of the Darklighter Estate? He's only the biggest business magnate on Tatooine.|Huff Darklighter's guard, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FHR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Finding Huff's Rifle|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Darklighter estate''' was a moisture farm on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
It was the home of [[Huff Darklighter]], and was owned by [[Jula Darklighter|Jula]] and [[Silya Darklighter]].

From above it looked like a compound surrounding a number of buildings including a tall tower. But the buildings were actually constructed below the planet's surface.

A [[Huff Darklighter's niece|niece]] of Huff Darklighter also lived in the estate during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="SWG:HD">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Huff Darklighter|Tatooine}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a number of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] visited the Darklighter estate, considering it to be one of Tatooine's greatest vistas.<ref name="SWG:PoI" /> During that time, an antique [[Tusken King (rank)|Tusken King's]] [[Cycler rifle/Legends|rifle]] that belonged to Huff Darklighter's grandfather was stolen by people working for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Borvo]] the Hutt.<ref name="SWG:FHR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Darklighter estate appears in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG:PoI" /> Here, players can take a quest to help return an antique Tusken King's rifle to Huff Darklighter.<ref name="SWG:FHR" />

Players must visit the Darklighter estate to complete the in-game [[W:c:swg:Panoramic Vistas: Tatooine|"Panoramic Vistas" collection]].<ref name="SWG:PVT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Panoramic Vistas: Tatooine}}</ref>
